tasks.label: check-seasonal-products-data
args: const fs=require('fs'); const {createClient}=require('@supabase/supabase-js'); const lines=fs.readFileSync('.env.local','utf8').split(/\r?\n/); const env={}; for(const line of lines){ if(!line || /^\s*#/.test(line) || !line.includes('=')) continue; const i=line.indexOf('='); const k=line.slice(0,i).trim(); const v=line.slice(i+1).trim().replace(/^\"|\"$/g,''); env[k]=v; } const supabase=createClient(env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, env.SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY); const norm=(v)=>String(v||'').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z]/g,' ').replace(/\s+/g,' ').trim(); (async()=>{ let from=0; const step=1000; const all=[]; while(true){ const {data,error}=await supabase.from('products').select('title,product_version,is_active,source,created_at').eq('is_active',true).or('source.is.null,source.neq.draft_workspace').range(from, from+step-1); if(error){ console.error('ERR', error.message); process.exit(1);} if(!data||data.length===0) break; all.push(...data); if(data.length<step) break; from+=step; } const winter=all.filter(p=>norm(p.product_version).includes('old') && norm(p.product_version).includes('pack') && String(p.title||'').toLowerCase().includes('winter')); const summer=all.filter(p=>norm(p.product_version).includes('old') && norm(p.product_version).includes('pack') && String(p.title||'').toLowerCase().includes('summer')); console.log('TOTAL_ACTIVE_NON_DRAFT', all.length); console.log('WINTER_OLD_PACKS', winter.length); console.log('SUMMER_OLD_PACKS', summer.length); console.log('SAMPLE_SUMMER', summer.slice(0,10).map(p=>p.title).join(' | ')); })();

tasks.label: check-live-api-seasonal-counts
args: $base='https://www.thekiddytrends.com/api/products?limit=400&page='; $all=@(); $page=1; while($true){ $res=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri ($base + $page) -Method Get; if(-not $res.products -or $res.products.Count -eq 0){ break }; $all += $res.products; if($page -ge [int]$res.pages){ break }; $page++ }; function norm($v){ return (($v | Out-String).Trim().ToLower() -replace '[^a-z]',' ' -replace '\s+',' ').Trim() }; $winter=@($all | Where-Object { (norm $_.product_version).Contains('old') -and (norm $_.product_version).Contains('pack') -and ($_.title.ToLower().Contains('winter')) }); $summer=@($all | Where-Object { (norm $_.product_version).Contains('old') -and (norm $_.product_version).Contains('pack') -and ($_.title.ToLower().Contains('summer')) }); Write-Output ('TOTAL=' + $all.Count); Write-Output ('WINTER_OLD_PACKS=' + $winter.Count); Write-Output ('SUMMER_OLD_PACKS=' + $summer.Count); Write-Output 'SAMPLE_SUMMER:'; $summer | Select-Object -First 8 | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ('- ' + $_.title + ' | ' + $_.product_version) }

tasks.label: check-live-api-seasonal-counts-v2
args: $all=@(); $page=1; while($true){ $url = "https://www.thekiddytrends.com/api/products?limit=400&page=$page"; $res=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $url -Method Get; if(-not $res.products -or $res.products.Count -eq 0){ break }; $all += $res.products; if($page -ge [int]$res.pages){ break }; $page++ }; function norm($v){ return (($v | Out-String).Trim().ToLower() -replace "[^a-z]"," " -replace "\s+"," ").Trim() }; $winter=@($all | Where-Object { (norm $_.product_version).Contains("old") -and (norm $_.product_version).Contains("pack") -and ($_.title.ToLower().Contains("winter")) }); $summer=@($all | Where-Object { (norm $_.product_version).Contains("old") -and (norm $_.product_version).Contains("pack") -and ($_.title.ToLower().Contains("summer")) }); Write-Output ("TOTAL=" + $all.Count); Write-Output ("WINTER_OLD_PACKS=" + $winter.Count); Write-Output ("SUMMER_OLD_PACKS=" + $summer.Count); Write-Output "SAMPLE_SUMMER:"; $summer | Select-Object -First 8 | ForEach-Object { Write-Output ("- " + $_.title + " | " + $_.product_version) }
